representedDate: Standing Plaza de la Cultura and underground museum
wholePhysicalScope: The Museo del Oro Precolombino and its built Plaza de la Cultura roof, with the recessed public approach on Calle 5, glazed entrance and underground concrete section.
lodDetails: All four levels preserve the mapped roof plaza, recessed entrance, three sloping-wall sublevels and spiral stair. Near views add stair railings, portal glazing details and coping.
limitations: Exterior roof bounds follow OpenStreetMap. The portal extent, terrace grades, precise stair/rail geometry, fountain position and modern fittings are estimates informed by the cleared photographs and public site notes.

The three-level internal massing follows the museum owner’s published vertical section facts. The gallery partitions, stair diameter and precise sublevel dimensions are estimated, with a simplified exhibition shell.

An approximate current placement masks the native ground within the actual built plaza boundaries, exposing the entrance court and replacing the modelled roof only. Native terrain data outside the authored roof is unchanged.
